claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor.
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 2 identify the model as EOS 5D Mark II, but the report does not show sensor resolution or full-frame status.

claims.claim: Seller provided additional photos shown as image placeholders.
claims.evidence: The image placeholders cannot be viewed or read remotely.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or core functions are defective.
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a picture, and playing it back.

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy internal wear.
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo showing the shutter count / number of actuations.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage with unknown wear.

risks.risk: Image sensor has dust, scratches, or dead pixels.
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor or a test shot of a plain white wall at a small aperture.

risks.risk: Autofocus, buttons, dials, or LCD screen do not work.
risks.proof: Video testing each button, dial, autofocus point, and screen display.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, or memory card missing or dead.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery, charger, and memory card, plus a clip showing the battery holding a charge.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without battery, charger, or card.

risks.risk: Original box, manuals, and accessories missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the box, manuals, and all accessories together.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in the three supplied angles.
risks.proof: Photos of the top, hot shoe, ports, and all sides of the body.
Warranty card, receipt, or screenshot of a Canon warranty status check.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, shooting, and reviewing an image.
Screenshot or photo showing the shutter count.
Photo of the image sensor or a white-wall test shot.
Video testing buttons, dials, autofocus, and LCD.
Photo of battery, charger, and memory card.
Photo of original box, manuals, and accessories.
Photos of all sides, hot shoe, and ports.
Warranty card or proof of purchase.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II, so it can be valued at its worst case—untested, body only, no warranty—while the listed proofs are collected to raise the value.
